segments.name: Waste and recycling management
segments.description: Provides waste and recycling management services to larger, multi-location businesses across multiple industry sectors.
segments.evidence: Our chief operating decision maker ("CODM"), the President and Chief Executive Officer, manages the Company's business activities as a single operating and reportable segment at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Business customers pay Quest for the collection, processing, recycling, disposal, and tracking of their waste streams and recyclables.
revenueModel.evidence: We create customer-specific programs and perform the related services for the collection, processing, recycling, disposal, and tracking of waste streams and recyclables to maximize resource utilization.

changes.text: In 2025, Quest sold substantially all assets of a business operation it divested as underperforming.
changes.evidence: The Company sold the assets to divest an underperforming business operation.
